note: Set A misbinds several values to the wrong detail: it assigns W8X13 to B1 FLOOR BEAM NEAR GRID 5 and W10X15 to E6 (both are reversed — B1 is W10X15, C1/E6 are W8X13), puts 10'-0" and 8" on details (near Grid 5, E6) whose dimension strings contain no such values, and gives FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 4 a 5'-0" length that actually belongs to the B4/FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 3 detail. Set B correctly ties W10X15 to A4, B1 and Grid 5 beams, ø 3" to the C1 and E6 roof beams, and 4'-2"/3'-1" to the B1 (FLOOR BEAM NEAR GRID 5) detail. Set B's main errors are calling the 2" dimension a 'top flange width' on Detail B4 and assigning 2'-6" to Detail C4, where that dimension does not appear (it belongs to C1). Both sets contain vague, unlocalized opening claims, but Set B keeps conditions and values consistently bound to the correct details.
